ValidationRule.description: Price format should be consistent with Value Type : either Percentage, or Currency
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), AND(TEXT(ER_ValueType__c)='Percentage', ISBLANK(ER_Percentage__c)), AND(TEXT(ER_ValueType__c)='Currency', ISBLANK(UnitPrice)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRER04 - Price format should be consistent with Value Type : either Percentage, or Currency.
